summary: Eagle Point Income Company filed an Item 8.01 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing management's unaudited quarterly estimates rather than a corporate transaction. Estimated NAV per common share as of September 30, 2026, ranges from $12.34 to $12.44, while estimated net investment income plus realized investment losses for the quarter ranges from $0.65 to $0.69 per weighted average common share. The filing is signed by CFO/COO Kenneth P. Onorio. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, premium, or structural mechanics appear. Watch for eventual audited results and any NAV drift versus estimates after quarter-end.
